description:
I am a Grade 8 student who is interested in science, space, and technology. I enjoy learning new things, exploring ideas, and solving problems creatively.

My project explores NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. I am interested in connecting with friendly, creative, and hardworking students who enjoy space, research, coding, design, or storytelling.

Everyone is welcome to share ideas, learn together, and contribute!
summary: I independently created an educational website titled “Abandoned but Not Forgotten: NASA Equipment on the Moon and Mars.” The website explores NASA equipment left behind during space missions, including lunar experiments, landers, rovers, and the Ingenuity helicopter. Visitors can explore photographs, discover each artifact’s purpose, learn about its mission, and understand why it was left behind. I also included a space exploration timeline and interesting facts to make learning more engaging. My project addresses the challenge by bringing attention to NASA equipment that is often forgotten and explaining its scientific and historical importance. It shows how these machines and instruments contributed to space exploration and helped us learn more about the Moon and Mars. I developed this project independently with guidance from my teacher, Mr. Akbar Sha.
